segments.title: Trump Conviction Fallout & Legal Analysis
segments.notes: Case Blackwell anchors breaking coverage of Trump's guilty verdict on 34 counts, discusses jail prospects with Rick and legal expert Little Tommy Big Law.

segments.title: Transition to Field Coverage
segments.notes: Blackwell hands off to Trip Bradstein for street-level reactions to the verdict.

segments.title: Park Denizens React to Historic Verdict
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein interviews a Canadian, Nina Hartley's gardener, Bernie Madoff's ghost from hell, Jail Johnny with Ernest Goes to Jail electricity powers, an extraterrestrial offering a new Trudeau model, and a generous park resident named Chip.

segments.title: Post-Street Debrief & Cheese Update
segments.notes: Blackwell returns to desk, acknowledges Epstein resub, discusses cheese consumption and upcoming How To segment.

segments.title: Boiled Eggs, Chocolate-Toothpaste Sandwiches & Whiskey Protocol
segments.notes: Jeb Nogget demonstrates egg-blowing technique, watches a Hindi/English cooking video featuring mint toothpaste as green paste, and attempts to drink whiskey 'like a sir' with guidance from his wood-trapped father.

segments.title: Sammy's Prosthetic Thumb Special & Court Sketch Roast
segments.notes: Correspondent Sammy commandeers the desk to cover Cambridge University's third thumb prosthetic, runs a prosthetic body part poll (Gooch vs Tail tie), pitches Gooch & Tail Pixar movie, and roasts courtroom sketches of Trump.

segments.title: Pre-Debate Wind-Down
segments.notes: Blackwell wraps Sammy's segment, notes schedule normalization goals, and tees up Munch & Crum.

segments.title: Trump Jail Debate & Unexpected Civility
segments.notes: Munch argues Trump should not go to jail (precedent/civil unrest); Crum agrees he should but concedes the 'no' side per debate rules. Uncharacteristic warmth emerges; score updates to Crum 97.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Schedule Announcement
segments.notes: Blackwell closes broadcast, announces 12:30 PST consistency goal, raids Casim.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored Trump conviction coverage, hosted Little Tommy Big Law, handed off to Trip and Jeb, closed with schedule announcement.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Briefly appeared in Jeb segment trapped-in-wood bit; confirmed 'porn addict' by chat.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debated Munch on Trump jail question, unusually cooperative, score updated to 97.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued against Trump jail on precedent grounds, showed uncharacteristic warmth toward Crum, suggested burying the axe.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: instructional host. Hosted How To segment: boiled egg technique, chocolate-toothpaste sandwich reaction, whiskey tasting with father's ghost.

characters.name: Trip Bradstein
characters.notes: field correspondent. Conducted street interviews on Trump verdict: Canadian, Nina Hartley's gardener, Bernie Madoff's ghost, Jail Johnny, extraterrestrial, Chip.

characters.name: Little Tommy Big Law
characters.notes: call-in guest. Provided toddler legal analysis: Trump punished for not saying sorry, no snacks/jail time, bills $1000/minute.

characters.name: Sammy
characters.notes: correspondent. Commandeered desk for prosthetic thumb coverage, ran body-part poll, pitched Gooch & Tail movie, roasted court sketches.

characters.name: Rick
characters.notes: correspondent. Briefly discussed Trump jail logistics and secret service before Blackwell cut to Little Tommy.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Referenced at close: possibly working, Blackwell may game later if she's gone.

storylines.beat: Crum appears in Munch & Crum debate with score at 97, showing unusual civility and cooperation with Munch; no direct reference to gorilla wager or groin punch forfeit.

lore_notes.fact: Owns extremely old unopened Maker's Mark whiskey gifted by Case Blackwell; attempted to drink it 'like a sir' without ice per instructional video, got instantly drunk on one sip.
Has a 'little brother' mentor program picking up a 32-year-old from prison; claimed drunkenness prevented pickup.
Debate score updated to 97 wins; Munch acknowledged trading wins back and forth.
Expressed desire to 'bury the axe' with Crum after spiritual concussion; thanked Crum for reasonable debate partnership.
Self-styled 'Sammy Six Elbows'; brought personal beverage from home; pitched Gooch & Tail Pixar film starring Zachary Levi.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered Trump's historic felony conviction with legal analysis from toddler attorney Little Tommy Big Law, street reactions from Trip Bradstein's park interviewees including a hell-dwelling Bernie Madoff and an extraterrestrial Trudeau salesman, a How To with Jeb segment on boiled eggs and whiskey protocol that left Jeb instantly intoxicated, and a Sammy-hosted deep dive on Cambridge's prosthetic third thumb. Munch & Crum debated Trump's jail prospects with uncharacteristic civility, updating Crum's debate score to 97. Blackwell announced a 12:30 PST consistency goal before raiding Casim.
